## Current caption

> Tycho Brahe at his mural quadrant in Uraniborg, from Astronomiae Instauratae Mechanica (1598). Tycho is seated within the arc of the great quadrant while an assistant sights toward a star and another records the time. The quadrant's six-foot radius allowed division to fractions of an arc-minute. This collaborative approach—precise instruments, trained assistants, careful record-keeping—established the model Flamsteed would refine at Greenwich.
